tool: Codex CLI (codex exec), model gpt-6-astra, built-in image generation
purpose: A 6wines red wine bottle that replaces the mug once the 6wines sticker is pulled off the monitor.

references.label: 6wines wordmark SVG from https://www.6wines.nl/ rendered in burgundy (#511027)

prompts.day:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE new asset for a layered website illustration.

Attached images:
- mug-day.png: an existing asset from the same scene (a ceramic coffee mug on a transparent 1536x1024 canvas). Use it ONLY as the reference for art style, rendering quality, daylight lighting direction, camera angle and the soft baked contact shadow. Do not include the mug.
- 6wines-logo.png: the "6wines" wordmark. Reproduce it on the bottle's label.

Use case: new isolated object asset. Create a single bottle of RED WINE standing upright, seen from the same slightly-elevated three-quarter front camera as the mug, in the same polished, cozy, Pixar-like stylized 3D look and the same soft warm daylight from the camera-left window. Dark green glass with subtle reflections and a hint of the deep red wine inside, a dark burgundy foil capsule on the neck, and a cream paper front label showing the "6wines" wordmark (burgundy lettering, exactly as in 6wines-logo.png, legible, centred on the label). No other text on the label.

CRITICAL format requirements:
- Exactly 1536x1024 PNG with a REAL alpha-transparent background everywhere outside the bottle and its shadow. No white or coloured backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no table.
- The bottle centred horizontally, standing vertically, filling about 85% of the canvas height.
- A soft, translucent baked contact shadow directly under its base, like the mug's.
- One object only. No sprite sheet, no captions, no extra props, no glass.

Save the result as /tmp/winegen/wine-day.png. Reply with just the saved path.
prompts.night:
Use your built-in image generation tool to edit an asset for a layered website illustration.

Attached images:
- wine-day.png: the EDIT TARGET, a red wine bottle with a "6wines" label on a real alpha-transparent 1536x1024 canvas, lit for daytime.
- mug-night.png: an existing NIGHT asset from the same scene. Use it ONLY as the lighting reference.

Use case: lighting-weather. Create the NIGHT lighting variant of wine-day.png. CRITICAL: change illumination only. Keep the exact same bottle, label, "6wines" wordmark, shape, size, position, silhouette and camera; pixel-registered to wine-day.png. Light it like mug-night.png: a cosy evening room with a warm amber table lamp to camera-right giving a warm rim and highlight on the right side of the glass and label, and a dimmer, cooler, darker left side. Keep the soft translucent contact shadow under the base.

CRITICAL format: exactly 1536x1024 PNG with REAL alpha transparency everywhere outside the bottle and its shadow. No backdrop, no checkerboard. One object only, no captions.

Save the result as /tmp/winegen/wine-night.png. Reply with just the saved path.
prompts.empty-day:
Use your built-in image generation tool to edit an asset for a layered website illustration.

Attached: wine-day.png is the EDIT TARGET: a sealed, full red wine bottle with a "6wines" label on a real alpha-transparent 1536x1024 canvas.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Turn it into the SAME bottle after it has been drunk: EMPTY and OPENED. Remove the burgundy foil capsule and the cork so the bare open glass neck and lip are visible; the dark green glass is now empty and see-through (no red wine inside, maybe only a thin red film at the very bottom). Keep the exact same bottle shape, size, position, label and "6wines" wordmark, camera and daylight lighting; pixel-registered to wine-day.png. Keep the soft translucent contact shadow under the base.

CRITICAL format: exactly 1536x1024 PNG with REAL alpha transparency everywhere outside the bottle and its shadow (the empty glass may be partly translucent). No backdrop, no checkerboard, no cork or capsule lying around, no captions.

Save the result as /tmp/winegen2/wine-empty-day.png. Reply with just the saved path.
prompts.empty-night:
Use your built-in image generation tool to edit an asset for a layered website illustration.

Attached images:
- wine-night-src.png: the EDIT TARGET, a sealed full red wine bottle with a "6wines" label, lit for NIGHT (warm amber lamp light from the right, cooler darker left), on a real alpha-transparent 1536x1024 canvas.
- wine-empty-day.png: the SAME bottle after drinking, in daylight. Match its empty, opened state exactly.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Turn the night bottle into the empty, opened bottle shown in wine-empty-day.png: foil capsule and cork removed (bare open glass neck and lip), empty see-through dark green glass with only a thin red film at the bottom. Keep the NIGHT lighting of wine-night-src.png (warm amber highlight on the right, dimmer cooler left) and the exact same shape, size, position, label and "6wines" wordmark; pixel-registered. Keep the soft translucent contact shadow under the base.

CRITICAL format: exactly 1536x1024 PNG with REAL alpha transparency everywhere outside the bottle and its shadow. No backdrop, no checkerboard, no captions.

Save the result as /tmp/winegen2/wine-empty-night.png. Reply with just the saved path.
prompts.look-bottle-day:
Use your built-in image generation tool to edit an animation frame for a layered website illustration.

Attached: day-smile.png is the EDIT TARGET: a seated stylized 3D man on a real alpha-transparent 1536x1024 canvas.

Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit. Make exactly ONE facial change: he has just noticed a bottle of wine that popped up on the desk to the lower right of the image (his left). Turn BOTH pupils and irises to look clearly toward the lower RIGHT of the image, and RAISE BOTH EYEBROWS high in delighted surprise, with a small pleased smile. CRITICAL INVARIANTS: keep the exact 1536x1024 canvas, transparent background, same man, hair silhouette, head position and size, ears, nose, outfit, complete connected body, hands, fingers, feet and every body pose pixel. Camera perfectly locked, EXACT soft daylight lighting of the input. Change ONLY the eyes, eyebrows and mouth. This frame must register with the original. No new objects, no text. Genuine alpha transparency, preserve the original baked contact shadows.

Save the result as /tmp/winegen2/day-look-bottle.png. Reply with just the saved path.
prompts.look-bottle-night:
Use your built-in image generation tool to edit an animation frame for a layered website illustration.

Attached images:
- night-smile.png: the EDIT TARGET, a seated stylized 3D man lit for NIGHT on a real alpha-transparent 1536x1024 canvas.
- day-look-bottle.png: the same man in daylight with the target expression.

Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit. Give night-smile.png exactly the facial expression of day-look-bottle.png: BOTH pupils and irises looking clearly toward the lower RIGHT of the image, BOTH eyebrows raised high in delighted surprise, small pleased smile. CRITICAL INVARIANTS: keep the exact 1536x1024 canvas, transparent background, same man, hair silhouette, head position and size, ears, nose, outfit, complete connected body, hands, fingers, feet and every body pose pixel of night-smile.png. Camera perfectly locked and keep its EXACT night lighting. Change ONLY the eyes, eyebrows and mouth. No new objects, no text. Genuine alpha transparency, preserve the baked contact shadows.

Save the result as /tmp/winegen2/night-look-bottle.png. Reply with just the saved path.

postprocessing: Alpha stretched from a 254 maximum to fully opaque; saved as sources/wine.png and night/sources/wine.png, then scripts/prepare-office-assets.ts measured the bounds and encoded the WebPs.
